User.title: User
User.description: User profile with numeric ID mapping and daily coins

Order.title: Order
Order.description: An invoice-style batch order containing multiple items shared between two users

userId.description: UID of user who placed the order

items.description: List of order items with quantity, purchase/unavailable status and actual price

purchaseMarketName.description: Server-side manual market/bazar name entered at order completion

createdAtMs.description: Client epoch millis when order was created for local alarm scheduling

acceptedAtMs.description: Epoch millis when order was accepted

shoppingDurationMinutes.description: Planned shopping duration chosen upon acceptance

shoppingDeadlineMs.description: Epoch millis deadline after which the order is overdue

rejectionReason.description: Reason provided when receiver rejects the order

incompleteReason.description: Reason provided when buyer marks accepted order incomplete

MarketPurchase.title: MarketPurchase
MarketPurchase.description: Server-side record of the market or bazar name entered manually when an order is completed

userId.description: UID of user who purchased the item

requesterId.description: UID of user who requested the order

itemName.description: Name of purchased item or summary

marketName.description: Manually entered market or bazar name

GiftClaim.title: GiftClaim
GiftClaim.description: Delivery address submitted by a user who has collected at least 180 coins

coins.description: Coin balance at time of claim (>= 180)

AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Global admin-controlled runtime flags including app ON/OFF availability and coin feature toggle

appEnabled.description: When false, non-admin logins and access are disabled

coinFeatureEnabled.description: When false, coin & gift features are hidden

defaultNoticesSeeded.description: Whether initial notices have been seeded

/users/{numericId}.description: Directory of users indexed by 6-digit numeric ID

/orders/{orderId}.description: Invoice batch orders shared between two connected buddies

/market_purchases/{purchaseId}.description: Silent server-side log of markets where products were bought

/gift_claims/{claimUserId}.description: Private gift delivery address claims for users with 180+ coins (readable only by owner and admin)

/app_config/{configId}.description: Global application availability and feature flags controlled by Admin
